# Mammoth browser asset

Official mammoth 1.13.0, from https://www.npmjs.com/package/mammoth/v/1.13.0.
Source: https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js. BSD-2-Clause license retained in LICENSE.

The standalone browser bundle is loaded on demand for DOCX raw-text extraction. Only plain text is used and escaped when displayed. Document HTML is never inserted into the app.
